name: Supplier Management (MOF)
description: Supplier registration and MOF applications by a registered supplier: new MOF (contractor/consultant), add category (with site visits), update profile, bumiputera, renewal, cancel MOF account, delete pending application, rejections. Status = SM_WORKFLOW_STATUS (type SR) of the application number (AP, e.g. KN-06112026-0058). Steps are MANUAL in the flow runner; the new-MOF chain itself is automated in tests/sm/registration (REG-001..004), catalogue (CAT-001) and soft cert (SC-001..004).
